Please format all spreadsheets in all .xlsx files in the following manner...
- Calibri 12 point black font with a "no fill" background in all cells   
- All cells should be centered
- Column names should be all caps and Bolded
- Freeze column names for scrolling purposes
- Column width is too wide.  Columns should only be wide enough to include text contained in the column
- Do not add AutoFilter (the drop-down arrows on the column headers) to any table
